financing.summary: Saratoga Homes is a private, family-owned Texas builder with no public debt, no SEC filings and no published lot counts. Recorded county deeds of trust (via a data aggregator) show it funds construction and lots with secured bank loans from Texas and regional banks (International Bank of Commerce, Texas Capital Bank, Flagstar, WestStar, Citizens Bank of Las Cruces), largely house-by-house or project loans in the operating LLCs and its affiliated JNC Development, Inc. No land banker, lot-option partner, capital partner or JV is publicly named, and no link to Domain, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found. For a land banker this is open ground: a bank-financed family builder of about 700 closings a year that appears to own its land and lots through family entities.
financing.land_strategy: Not publicly stated. Public records point to owning lots and land through the operating LLCs and the affiliated JNC Development, Inc., financed with bank debt; the company says it develops its own subdivisions ('we work to develop subdivisions, parks, and communities') and also buys into third-party master plans (e.g. Lakeside at Tessera on Lake Travis, Austin).
